content:
pagerbot: [PAGER] High-rate auth failures observed on inference-proxy (svc: log-forwarder) at 05:12 UTC. Suspicious outbound log uploads to an external S3 bucket detected. Severity: P0.

mike_oncall: Ack — oncall Mike. Starting triage now.

sre_lead: Mike, preserve logs and packet captures. Tagging sec_ops and legal.

alice_sre: grabbing logs and sampling the forwarder pod output. quick grep first.

alice_sre: ```bash
# quick sample checks
kubectl logs deploy/log-forwarder -n infra --since=10m | head -n 200
# look for external s3 endpoints
kubectl logs deploy/log-forwarder -n infra | grep "s3.amazonaws.com"
```

alice_sre: found ~92 PUT requests to s3://external-bucket-zz between 05:09-05:13 UTC. samples include header fragment: `X-Forwarded-Auth: token=***` (truncated).

sec_ops: treat this as potential exfil. Immediate actions: 1) block egress from forwarder, 2) rotate service-account keys, 3) snapshot/preserve evidence.

mike_oncall: executing egress block now. updating NAT rules.

alice_sre: ran scale down: `kubectl scale deployment/log-forwarder --replicas=0 -n infra` — pods terminating, no new outbound observed.

sec_ops: starting key rotation for svc-forwarder. Follow ops-runbook rotate-service-account-keys. Posting minimal runbook snippet for oncall: 
```text
1) create a new key in KMS / IAM for svc-forwarder
2) update secret redwood/log-forwarder-svcacct in Vault with new credentials
3) rollout forwarder with updated secret and monitor for errors
4) once stable, revoke old key and record rotation in audit log
```

mike_oncall: created new key, updated Vault secret, and triggered rollout. watching health and job backlog.

alice_sre: confirmed ACL change: infra-NAT egress rule now denies outbound to external-bucket-zz IPs. 0 PUTs observed in the last 60s.

cust_success: FYI — this may affect customers who stream logs externally. Preparing customer-facing template, will wait for legal.

legal: joining the thread. Please preserve all artifacts and provide scope: which buckets, what objects, any PII in samples?

sec_ops: early forensics: samples include http paths and auth header fragments but no full payloads so far. Forensics team will pull full artifact set to incidents bucket.

mike_oncall: creating incident timeline: alert 05:12 UTC, forwarder scaled down 05:13, egress rule applied 05:14, keys rotated 05:18. Will update every 15m.

cust_success: draft message: "We detected suspicious activity from an internal log-forwarder and proactively disabled external exports. No evidence of customer data access at this time; investigation is ongoing and we will update you." OK to hold?

legal: wording looks fine; add "under investigation" and provide a contact channel. Keep customer comms conservative.

alice_sre: archiving raw artifacts to s3://redwood-incidents/8095012345/ for the security team. Command used: `aws s3 cp /tmp/forensics/ s3://redwood-incidents/8095012345/ --recursive --sse aws:kms`

sec_ops: logging timeline entries into the incident tracker. Evidence saved: forwarder logs, NAT ACL changes, Vault rotation records, KMS key creation.

mike_oncall: summary: mitigation actions taken (egress block, forwarder disabled, keys rotated, artifacts preserved). Next steps: post-mortem, alert tuning to reduce noise, CI review of forwarder deployment permissions.

cust_success: I'll prepare the CS queue and hold until legal signs off.

legal: will review and sign off on customer template in ~10m.

mike_oncall: good job team. Pager cleared for now, tracking follow-ups on the incident card. :white_check_mark:
